description: OQ6 states GROQ_API_KEY is 'Now UNUSED on the live path (voice = Gemini Live)'. This is directly falsifiable and false: GROQ_API_KEY gates the ENTIRE /ws connection on the live path today. server.js:358-361 closes any carrier WebSocket that connects when GROQ_KEY is unset, before any auth or call logic runs: 'if (!GROQ_KEY) { console.error("[bridge] GROQ_API_KEY missing — cannot run compositional voice (no Live fallback); closing"); ... }'. GROQ_KEY is also the credential passed into stt()/llm() at server.js:401-409 for every live call. This is the same root fabrication as FIND-001 (spec believes Gemini Live is the live path when it is Groq compositional voice) surfacing in a second, independently checkable location.
